text:
tara: Heads-up for folks flying into SFO midday — landing ~12:30 and dragging a small suitcase. Quick recs near SoMa: Chinatown dim sum spot (walkable, lots of seats) vs postage-stamp sandwich shop on 4th (grab-and-go). Need something fast, able to seat 4, and at least one GF option. Thoughts?
josh: Dim sum sounds fun but can be slow at peak. Is there a place that does to-go trays?
priya: FYI if anyone needs vegetarian/halal options Chinatown has a few veggie dim sum plates. Also some places pack to-go steamers.
emily: Sandwich shop (Corner Press) will pack everything super fast. Has GF bread and outlets if you need to charge. Map: https://maps.example/cornerpress-soma
rafael: :dumpling: for dim sum if we don't mind a 15-20 min wait. Pro: more options for my pescatarian partner.
ara (typo): (oops wrong channel)
priya: Also consider "Rolling Basket" on Kearny — they do family-style dim sum and pre-made boxes for groups. Usually quick if you call ahead.
tara: Can we poll? react with :dumpling: for dim sum, :bread: for sandwich shop. Lunchbot: please run quick poll.
lunchbot: Poll started: react with :dumpling: (Dim sum) or :bread: (Sandwich shop). Poll auto-closes in 3h.
josh: :bread: (leaning practical today)
priya: :dumpling: (but can call ahead)
emily: :bread: (suitcase + speed)
rafael: :dumpling: 
tara: Ok seems split 2-2. Given luggage and outlets Ill bias to Corner Press for speed. If someone really wants dim sum and can meet 15m later, we can do Rolling Basket next street for round two.
priya: Works for me. If we pick Corner Press can someone grab a table inside for 4? Theyre tiny.
emily: Ill grab the table and order ahead 10m before landing. Anyone specific allergies?
josh: No nuts, no shellfish for me.
rafael: Shellfish ok for me.
tara: Noted — emily please ask for GF bread and "no nuts" on josh's order.
emily: Will do. ETA 12:50. See you outside the 3rd St BART exit.
lunchbot: Reminder: poll closes in 45m.
priya: If Corner Press runs out of GF bread, Rolling Basket is backup.
tara: Thanks all. Quick, short, and luggage-friendly it is. :thumbsup:
